skipReason: The Elthetokerk (Cornelis Kruyswijk, 1929, Amsterdam School, 850 seats) was closed and demolished in 1992 (Wikipedia, nl). No church building stands at the POI: every BAG pand within about 60 m was built 1912-1916 housing, so there is no 3DBAG shell or present facade to model. Only a historic photo (Stadsarchief Amsterdam OSIM00004001397, 1932) exists; modelling a lost building into the current street would put a non-existent landmark on the map. The POI should stay as a plain quiz destination or be retired.
